title: Date Pudding with Saudi Twist
description: A unique dessert that brings together the richness of date pudding with the flavors of the Middle East. This Saudi-inspired dessert is a must-try for adventurous foodies.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, date syrup, and muscat dates.
Add velvety milk and whisk until smooth.
Add zesty lemon juice and vanilla extract. Mix well.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the pudding is set.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm or chilled, garnished with additional muscat dates if desired.
